issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside stack-trace path runs on every error frame without caching.
issues.detail: getSourceMap is called per frame during error serialization. For a failing module it will readFileSync the same file (and its referenced map file) every time. No cache, no memoization. On a noisy test run this turns every error into N disk reads. Cache by file path, or at minimum by the moduleGraph entry.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes semantics of resolvedSources for all callers.
issues.detail: The old code resolved each source against the map URL itself; the new code resolves against the map's parent directory. That is the correct sourcemap spec behavior, but DecodedMap is shared utility code. No test in packages/utils covers this, and the only evidence it works is a snapshot in test/cli. Add a direct unit test for resolvedSources so the next person touching this doesn't regress it back.

issues.description: Returning '{}' as a fake source map string to swallow bad filenames is bad taste.
issues.detail: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns the literal string '{}' when the referenced file is missing, so convert-source-map parses an empty object and pretends success. This hides real problems (broken sourceMappingURL, missing .map file) behind a silent no-op. Return undefined/null and let the caller decide, or log once at debug level. Don't lie to the parser.

issues.description: readFileSync without a try/catch on a hot error path can itself throw.
issues.detail: existsSync + readFileSync is racy and readFileSync can still throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop). If it throws inside parseErrorStacktrace's getSourceMap callback, the original error reporting dies and the user sees a sourcemap error instead of their test failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall through to no source map.

issues.description: Two patches in one: dependency + license addition is fine, but the source-map.ts resolve fix is logically independent.
issues.detail: The resolvedSources fix in packages/utils and the external-module sourcemap extraction in vitest/node are two bugs with two different blast radii. Squashed together they make bisecting a future regression harder. Not a blocker, but next time, two commits.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file with no reason.
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from 'pathe' at the top. The new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. Pick one. The codebase's voice is pathe; match it unless there's a concrete reason (there isn't here).

review.summary: Real bug, real fix, mostly the right shape. The one-line change in DecodedMap is correct per the sourcemap spec and the snapshot diff proves it. The external-module path in test-run.ts is the load-bearing addition and it works, but it has the smell of code written under deadline: sync I/O on a hot error path with no cache, no try/catch, and a fake '{}' return that lies to convert-source-map about missing files. None of these are architectural — they're tighten-the-screws fixes before this lands. NEEDS-WORK: cache the read, handle throws, stop returning '{}', and add a unit test for resolvedSources so the utility fix doesn't get reverted by someone who doesn't know why it changed.
